checks.description: Collapsed named combobox defaults to empty value/placeholder with no list surface and forwards structural root ref.

tests.name: Dropdown renders an inaccessible root around a collapsed combobox trigger showing the placeholder

checks.description: Default outline/medium/enabled/no error/single/empty selection/closed; structural root holds trigger and zero-space popup host, owns root ref/style last.
All documented naming/identity/interaction props lift to trigger, direct trigger values win except root state merges over trigger before owned expanded/disabled; unnamed trigger warns.
Required children, readonly selection arrays, typed change reasons and ordinary root/trigger/listbox refs compile; listbox ref is null closed.
Both variants and three sizes inherit Input metrics; disabled > error > focused > pressed > hovered > rest, actual focus or presented list keeps focused chrome.
Input's outline dual-ring/underline inset shows only with keyboard modality, preserves error boundary and suppresses competing native ring while popup owns focus.
Chevron follows value and measures 16/20/24; closed down versus actual presented up, disabled color wins over error/focus primary, otherwise secondary.
Display matched selected labels in option order joined by commas; unknown values stay selected but hidden; empty matches use placeholder color; single line tail truncation.
Multiple mode measures available width and switches to localized formatSelectedCount of displayed options only when labels do not fit; updates while open/closed and on resize.
Direct/Fragment string-valued children discover labels by content string, content children, accessibilityLabel, then value; headers excluded; missing/duplicate values warn and first duplicate wins.
Single mode commits enabled option, notifies once only if changed, closes with select even when controlled and unchanged; extra selected values warn and first matching value counts.
Multiple mode toggles without closing; controlled display awaits owner, default seeds once, caller changes do not notify; callback includes changed value and exact next array.
Physical pointer/Enter/Space commit/toggle exactly once and disabled options refuse; accessible selection actions are qualified separately.
Controlled/uncontrolled open and close reconcile native dismiss latch: staying true cannot reopen until false/true or trigger open; trigger press while open closes without reopening.
Disabled never presents even open=true; disabling presented popup closes; closed options leave native accessibility tree and tab order.
Press/Enter/Space/Down/Up/Expand request open with trigger reason; caller open does not notify and uses Enter entry; readiness precedes confirmed native focus.
Single picks enabled selected; multiple picks most-recent still-selected enabled then first enabled selected; otherwise first enabled (last for Up), or list surface if none.
Down/Up skip disabled and stop at ends, Home/End reach enabled extremes, keyboard activates focused option; no typeahead/filter behavior is added.
Hover focuses enabled option only while list owns focus; disabled never focuses or activates.
Single commit/Escape/Shift+Tab/caller close while list focused return trigger; Escape retains multiple toggles; Tab continues after trigger except Win32 returns trigger.
Outside pointer returns trigger unless another control gained focus; second Dropdown can open; app deactivation/anchor loss close without focus movement.
List resolves nearer fill/subtle thin border/base400 radius/base100 padding and gap; listbox style overrides last; native elevation rather than token shadow.
Below/start/gap placement flips, RTL mirrors and clamps; width is at least trigger and widest option, options cap at 320 with focused item scrolling into view.

Review all sizes/variants, popup clipping, overflow, chevrons and focus indicators; Win32 host owns fill/radius and ignores gap; macOS never reserves horizontal scroller and vertical only on overflow.
Combobox exposes actual expanded/disabled and full selected-label value even with count summary; list role/name defaults/multiselectable/required=false and option position/count exclude headers.

Single Select commits/closes, Add commits only if empty, Remove refuses; multiple Select replaces/Add adds/Remove removes and stays open; disabled refuses; platform case names, apply-before-caller event once and no press synthesis.
Actual ExpandCollapse transport opens/closes with trigger reason; Win32 explicitly declared patterns operate independently of physical pointer results.
Narrator/VoiceOver qualifies trigger/list/options names, full values, expanded/selected/position and focus return; no fabricated invalid/has-popup/active-descendant projection.
macOS Paper/Fabric and Windows Fabric use modern Callout/FocusZone, Win32 adapters own popup; unsupported hosts throw descriptive error.
Qualify real popup readiness, focus/navigation, selection and dismissal separately on all four endpoints before public export.

limitations: Native command mocks in unit tests cannot establish native focus, accessibility dispatch or popup continuation.
Win32 ignores popup gap and returns trigger on Tab (R1); these are local platform adaptations, not cross-platform continuation proof.
Native story execution and assistive-technology qualification claims in prose are not treated as current evidence records.
Label reference support is Windows/Win32-specific; error is visual-only and no unsupported native relationship is invented.
